Plot energy-balance closure diagnostics

Source: R/energy_balance_closure.R
plot_energy_balance_closure.Rd

Visualizes output from energy_balance_closure(). This is a plotting helper for diagnostics, not a flux model. It does not compute new turbulent fluxes and does not alter the diagnostic object.

Usage

plot_energy_balance_closure(
  x,
  type = c("residual", "ratio"),
  methods = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

Output from energy_balance_closure().

type

Plot type. "residual" plots closure residuals and Penman unresolved complements. "ratio" plots finite closure ratios for paired methods.

methods

Optional character vector of methods to include.

...

Additional arguments passed to base plotting functions.

Value

Invisibly returns x.

Details

For residual plots, paired methods use closure_residual. Penman uses unresolved_complement, labelled explicitly as such; the Penman complement is not sensible heat. Monin/Profile residuals remain diagnostic and are not forced to close.

Ratio plots use closure_ratio for paired methods only. Penman is excluded because fieldClim does not provide a paired Penman sensible heat flux. Rows marked low_available_energy are omitted from ratio plots because closure ratios are unstable near zero available energy.
